article.title: How Israel became America’s arms dealer
article.author: Sana Saeed
article.content: In episode three of The Necessary State, Sana Saeed traces how Israel became one of America’s most useful intermediaries, carrying U.S. military power, weapons, and influence into places where Washington wants a foothold without direct involvement.
